notes: PROVISIONAL story content for the shared interaction-dialogue contract v1 test. Election-morning exchange at the fictional Polling Unit 001. Wording, Nigerian English/Pidgin usage, officer title and any procedural detail need story, cultural and procedure review before use. Deliberately avoids real institution names, times and step-by-step voting procedure.

greeting.speaker: polling_officer
greeting.text: Good morning, you're welcome. You came early o. We are still setting up. Are you here to vote?

confirm_unit.speaker: polling_officer
confirm_unit.text: Yes, this is Polling Unit 001, here in the school. If this is where you registered, you are in the right place.

wait_instructions.speaker: polling_officer
wait_instructions.text: No wahala. Keep your card with you and wait under the canopy where there is shade. When everything is ready, we will announce it so everybody hears.

responses.text: I'll come back a bit later.

farewell_later.speaker: polling_officer
farewell_later.text: That's fine. Just don't come too late, the line will be long.
